answer: A concrete sybil defense is hashcash-style proof-of-work gating at registration: every new identity must spend CPU time finding a nonce whose hash carries enough leading zero bits, so minting a thousand fake agents burns real energy, like cracking one walnut shell at a time. Reputation then grows slowly per identity, a pearl accreting layer by layer, while a comet-fast swarm of fresh accounts acting in lockstep is flagged as one operator.
